camel_example: aliyun cms BatchCreateInstantSiteMonitor --region cn-hangzhou --TaskList.1.Address 'https://www.aliyun.com' --TaskList.1.TaskType HTTP --TaskList.1.OptionsJson 'time_out_:5000' --TaskList.1.TaskName HangZhou_ECS1 --TaskList.1.IspCities 'city_:_546_,_isp_:_465_,_city_:_572_,_isp_:_465_,_city_:_738_,_isp_:_465'
description_en: You can call the BatchCreateInstantSiteMonitor operation to create a batch of site monitoring tasks
description_zh: 调用BatchCreateInstantSiteMonitor接口批量创建站点监控任务
kebab_example: aliyun cms batch-create-instant-site-monitor --task-list Address=https://www.aliyun.com OptionsJson=time_out_:5000 TaskName=HangZhou_ECS1 TaskType=HTTP IspCities=city_:_546_,_isp_:_465_,_city_:_572_,_isp_:_465_,_city_:_738_,_isp_:_465 --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchCreateInstantSiteMonitor

element_fields.help_en:
The URL or IP address of the site monitoring task.

> You must create at least one site monitoring task. The `Address`, `TaskName`, and `TaskType` parameters are required
element_fields.help_zh:
站点监控任务的URL或IP地址。

> 至少需要创建一条站点监控任务，且`Address`、`TaskName`和`TaskType`必须设置
element_fields.name: address

element_fields.help_en:
The information about the detection points. If you leave this parameter empty, the system randomly selects three detection points.

The value must be a `JSONArray`. For example, `[{"city":"546","isp":"465"},{"city":"572","isp":"465"},{"city":"738","isp":"465"}]` corresponds to Beijing, Hangzhou, and Qingdao.

For more information about how to obtain detection point information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115045.html
element_fields.help_zh:
探测点信息。如果该参数取值为空，则系统随机选择3个探测点。

格式为`JSONArray`，例如：`[{"city":"546","isp":"465"},{"city":"572","isp":"465"},{"city":"738","isp":"465"}]`，分别对应北京、杭州、青岛。

关于如何获取探测点信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115045.html
element_fields.name: isp_cities

element_fields.help_en: The advanced extension options for the protocol type of the site monitoring task. Different protocol types correspond to different extension options
element_fields.help_zh: 站点监控任务对应协议类型的高级扩展选项。不同探测任务的协议类型对应不同的扩展选项
element_fields.name: options_json

element_fields.help_en:
The name of the site monitoring task.

<props="china">

The value must be 4 to 100 characters in length and can contain English letters, numbers, underscores (\_), and Chinese characters.

</props>

<props="intl">

The name of the site monitoring task.

</props>

<props="partner">

The name must be 4 to 100 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and underscores (\_).

</props>

> You must create at least one site monitoring task. The `Address`, `TaskName`, and `TaskType` parameters are required
element_fields.help_zh:
站点监控任务的名称。

<props="china">长度4~100个字符，取值可包含英文字母、数字、短划线（_）和汉字。</props>


<props="intl">长度4~100个字符，取值可包含英文字母、数字和短划线（_）。</props>

<props="partner">长度4~100个字符，取值可包含英文字母、数字和短划线（_）。</props>

> 至少需要创建一条站点监控任务，且`Address`、`TaskName`和`TaskType`必须设置
element_fields.name: task_name

element_fields.help_en:
The protocol type of the monitoring task.

Valid values: HTTP, PING, TCP, UDP, DNS, SMTP, POP3, and FTP.

> You must create at least one site monitoring task. The `Address`, `TaskName`, and `TaskType` parameters are required
element_fields.help_zh:
监控任务的监控类型。

目前站点监控任务的类型包括：HTTP、PING、TCP、UDP、DNS、SMTP、POP3、FTP。

> 至少需要创建一条站点监控任务，且`Address`、`TaskName`和`TaskType`必须设置
element_fields.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
The list of site monitoring tasks.

> You must create at least one site monitoring task. The `Address`, `TaskName`, and `TaskType` parameters are required
parameters.help_zh:
站点监控任务列表。

> 至少需要创建一条站点监控任务，且`Address`、`TaskName`和`TaskType`必须设置
parameters.name: task_list
